name: Two Love
source:
An English noble could no longer tolerate the torture of disease. Just when he decided to end his life, he met a traveler with black hair and red pupil...
An English vampire is still looking for what she wants. On Canvey Island, she sees a glimmer of possibility...
A talented woman chasing her enemies, a message came...
A killer from the East witnesses.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1180360/]Steam[/url]]
